panel.title: How to suggest a feature
panel.text:
Have an idea for CSFloat? Click **Suggest a feature** below.

🔍 **Search this forum first.** If your idea is already here, vote on it with ✅ instead of posting a new one.

The form has two short steps:
**1. Your idea:** where it applies, a title and a description
**2. Details:** why it's needed, plus optional sketches or examples

Your post is titled `[Area] - Title`, tagged, and posted here for the team to review. Other users can vote with ✅ or ❌.

fields.label: Area of the site
fields.description: Becomes a tag so the team can sort your post

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Your post will be titled: [Area] - Title
fields.placeholder: Add a button to accept multiple trades at once

fields.label: Description of the feature
fields.description: A clear, simple explanation of what you want us to add or change on CSFloat.
fields.placeholder: What should we add or change?

fields.label: Why is this needed?
fields.description: Why would this be useful? How does it improve things for you and other users?

fields.label: Visual examples (optional)
fields.description: Rough sketches, mockups or screenshots from other sites

fields.text: -# To keep this channel organized, requests that are incomplete, off-topic or duplicates may be closed or removed. Please check your answers before pressing **Submit**.
